import requests

def get_uniprot_info(gene_name):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene:{gene_name}+AND+organism_id:9606+AND+reviewed:true&format=json"
    r = requests.get(url)
    if r.status_code == 200:
        data = r.json()
        results = []
        for entry in data.get('results', []):
            acc = entry['primaryAccession']
            length = entry['sequence']['length']
            gene = [g.get('geneName', {}).get('value') for g in entry.get('genes', [])]
            results.append((acc, gene, length))
        return results
    return None

import requests

def get_ncbi_gene_info(gene_name):
    esearch_url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=gene&term={gene_name}[Gene+Name]+AND+human[Organism]&retmode=json"
    r = requests.get(esearch_url).json()
    id_list = r['esearchresult']['idlist']
    if not id_list:
        return None
    gene_id = id_list[0]
    esummary_url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=gene&id={gene_id}&retmode=json"
    r2 = requests.get(esummary_url).json()
    summary = r2['result'][gene_id]
    return {
        'gene_id': gene_id,
        'name': summary.get('name'),
        'description': summary.get('description'),
        'genomicinfo': summary.get('genomicinfo')
    }
